Remark
[Lie differentiation commutes with contraction]

Source: petersen:page-0089 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-tensor

1. ch2:2.5.10For a vector field $X$ and a $(1,1)$-tensor $S$:

  1. $\operatorname {tr}(L_XS)=L_X(\operatorname {tr}S)$;

  2. for $T(Y,Z)=g(S(Y),Z)$,

    \[ (L_XT)(Y,Z)=(L_Xg)(S(Y),Z)+g((L_XS)(Y),Z); \]

  3. contraction commutes with Lie differentiation.

Parts (1)--(2) are formalized; (3) awaits the general mixed-tensor contraction layer. \sketch Expanding the three Lie derivatives proves (2) by cancellation. For (1), torsion-freeness gives \[ L_XS= abla _XS-( abla X)\circ S+S\circ ( abla X). \] Taking traces, cyclicity cancels the last two terms, and section 5 gives the result.
